manaNeeded: {U}{R} plus enough mana to cast Blinkmoth Infusion and pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {4}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Cast Rootha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Activate Twinning Glass by paying {1} and tapping it, casting Rootha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Activate all mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Repeat from step 4.
